image_description: A full suit of polished steel plate armor standing in a museum setting. The image focuses on the torso, featuring a highly reflective breastplate with embossed details and gold-colored trim/straps at the shoulders and waist. Below the breastplate is a fauld (articulated waist armor) and tassets (thigh guards). The background shows wooden doors and a light-colored wall.
